turnout.notes: South Dakota turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout artifact is collected.

historicalBaselines.warning: South Dakota historical baseline rows are county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 Wikipedia county tables with source footnotes. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data.

reviewCharts.warning: South Dakota review rows are county-level President-versus-at-large-U.S.-House comparisons from secondary Wikipedia county tables that cite the South Dakota Secretary of State 2024 General Election Canvass and Certificate. They are useful as caveated staging/source-review coverage, but the official SOS canvass artifact or archive export still needs to be retained before treating the package as fully official native completion. These rows are not precinct-level vote-share scatter plots.
